\title{Upstream log: problems the brms-parity loop found in brms, Stan Math and loo}
\author{Generated from \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/log.json} by \texttt{tools/upstream\_log.py}}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\noindent Each entry is a place where brms, the Stan Math library as shipped with rstan's StanHeaders, or loo computes something wrong or inexactly, or accepts input it should refuse, found while AutoBayes was compared with brms (\texttt{docs/\allowbreak{}brms-\allowbreak{}parity/\allowbreak{}divergences.\allowbreak{}md}). Nothing here has been posted anywhere.

\noindent Every entry has a standalone R script that needs only CRAN brms, rstan and loo (no AutoBayes): it prints what the library gives next to the exact value, which it computes itself from a closed form or a stable log-space formula, and exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Densities and gradients come from \texttt{brm(\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{} chains =\allowbreak{} 0)} with \texttt{rstan::log\_\allowbreak{}prob} and \texttt{grad\_\allowbreak{}log\_\allowbreak{}prob} (the prior's part removed by evaluating the same compiled model with its \texttt{prior\_\allowbreak{}only} flag set); predictions from fixed-parameter runs. Nothing samples.

\noindent The fixes are described from the mathematics. brms's, loo's and Stan's source code was not read; where a cause is inferred from outputs it is said so. Known-upstream status comes from read-only searches of brms's NEWS and the paul-buerkner/brms, stan-dev/math and stan-dev/loo issue trackers.

\noindent Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, loo 2.9.0, R 4.5.2.

\noindent Entries: 30 reproduced, 1 not a bug after all.

\section{The entries}

\subsection{U01: hurdle\_negbinomial \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}predict(\allowbreak{})} does not draw the positive part from the zero-truncated negative binomial}
\label{U01}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: posterior\_predict(), hurdle\_negbinomial(). Wrong result; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] D03 (\#65); divergence D86. Recorded in \texttt{tests/\allowbreak{}zero\_\allowbreak{}hurdle\_\allowbreak{}probes}; reproduced independently in the Tier D review.
\item[What] The share of zeros is right (\texttt{hu}), but the positive draws are too concentrated at 1 and their mean is too small, so the draws contradict brms's own \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})}, which reports the zero-truncated mean.
\item[Observed] At \texttt{mu =\allowbreak{} 0.\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{} shape =\allowbreak{} 0.\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{} hu =\allowbreak{} 0.\allowbreak{}05} (fixed-parameter run, 100000 draws, 95122 positive): P(y = 1 \textbar{} y \textgreater{} 0) = 0.8164 and E[y \textbar{} y \textgreater{} 0] = 1.2709. At \texttt{mu =\allowbreak{} 3,\allowbreak{} shape =\allowbreak{} 2}: 0.2608 and 3.1557. At \texttt{mu =\allowbreak{} 0.\allowbreak{}05,\allowbreak{} shape =\allowbreak{} 0.\allowbreak{}2}: 0.9774 and 1.0246. \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})} gives 1.621751442, 3.392857143 and 1.088263927, the exact values.
\item[Expected] The zero-truncated negative binomial: P(y = 1 \textbar{} y \textgreater{} 0) = 0.6036, 0.2286, 0.8764 and E[y \textbar{} y \textgreater{} 0] = \texttt{mu /\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} NB(\allowbreak{}0))} = 1.7071, 3.5714, 1.1455 (between 24 and 134 standard errors from brms's draws).
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U01.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U01.out}.
\item[Fix] Draw the positive part by inverting the survival function on its own range: \texttt{v \textasciitilde{} Uniform(\allowbreak{}0,\allowbreak{} 1 -\allowbreak{} NB(\allowbreak{}0))}, \texttt{y =\allowbreak{} qnbinom(\allowbreak{}v,\allowbreak{} size =\allowbreak{} shape,\allowbreak{} mu =\allowbreak{} mu,\allowbreak{} lower.\allowbreak{}tail =\allowbreak{} FALSE)}, which is exactly the zero-truncated distribution and has no rejection loop when NB(0) is near 1.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U02: \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})} of a count response with \texttt{trunc(\allowbreak{}lb =\allowbreak{} )} starts the support at lb + 1 and cuts it off near 3 mu}
\label{U02}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: posterior\_epred(), fitted(), trunc() for negbinomial (and the other count families). Wrong result; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] E04 (\#77); divergence D121.
\item[What] The likelihood of \texttt{y \textbar{} trunc(\allowbreak{}lb =\allowbreak{} 1)} is normalised by P(Y \textgreater{}= 1), but the expected value is the mean over 2..M with a finite M, so it is neither E[Y \textbar{} Y \textgreater{}= 1] nor E[Y \textbar{} Y \textgreater{}= 2].
\item[Observed] Negative binomial \texttt{y \textbar{} trunc(\allowbreak{}lb =\allowbreak{} 1) \textasciitilde{} 1}: at \texttt{mu =\allowbreak{} 1.\allowbreak{}5,\allowbreak{} shape =\allowbreak{} 1} brms gives 2.673469388 = the mean over 2..4; at \texttt{mu =\allowbreak{} 134,\allowbreak{} shape =\allowbreak{} 0.\allowbreak{}6} it gives 102.6108362 = the mean over 2..402, whatever the data's largest count (5 or 300). On the frozen case \texttt{negbinomial\_\allowbreak{}truncated} (point 7, row 27) 106.236, the mean over 2..394.
\item[Expected] E[Y \textbar{} Y \textgreater{}= 1] = \texttt{mu /\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} NB(\allowbreak{}0))}: 2.5 and 139.4172675 (106.236 should be 133.95). The likelihood (checked with \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}prob}) is normalised by P(Y \textgreater{}= 1), so the expected value must be that distribution's.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U02.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U02.out}.
\item[Fix] For a lower bound alone use the closed form \texttt{E[Y \textbar{} Y \textgreater{}=\allowbreak{} lb] =\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}mu -\allowbreak{} sum\_\allowbreak{}\{k \textless{} lb\} k P(\allowbreak{}k)) /\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} F(\allowbreak{}lb -\allowbreak{} 1))}, which needs no truncation of the support; with both bounds sum \texttt{k P(\allowbreak{}k)} over \texttt{lb.\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{}ub} and divide by \texttt{F(\allowbreak{}ub) -\allowbreak{} F(\allowbreak{}lb -\allowbreak{} 1)}.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Known: the lb + 1 start is brms issue \#1923, fixed by PR \#1926 in the development version.
\\ \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms/issues/1923} (closed 2026-09-01): \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})} drops the lower bound for truncated discrete models
\\ \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms/pull/1926} (merged 2026-09-01): Include the lower bound in truncated discrete posterior\_epred
\\ Fixed in: the development version (2.23.2, NEWS: Include the lower bound when computing \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred} for truncated discrete models); CRAN still has 2.23.0 (checked 2026-10-21).
\\ The finite upper end of the support (about 3 mu here) for a lower bound alone is not mentioned in \#1923 and was not checked against the development version.
\end{description}

\subsection{U03: cumulative("cloglog") forms its upper categories' probabilities by subtraction; the log density loses them and is -Inf beyond d of about 3.6}
\label{U03}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: cumulative(link = "cloglog") (generated Stan code). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] E06 (\#71); divergence D132. The link was accepted on a narrower case (\#79); the frozen case \texttt{cumulative\_\allowbreak{}cloglog} keeps its G2 gates expected to fail.
\item[What] The last category's probability is \texttt{1 -\allowbreak{} inv\_\allowbreak{}cloglog(\allowbreak{}d)} and the others \texttt{inv\_\allowbreak{}cloglog(\allowbreak{}d\_\allowbreak{}k) -\allowbreak{} inv\_\allowbreak{}cloglog(\allowbreak{}d\_\allowbreak{}\{k-\allowbreak{}1\})}, formed by subtraction of numbers near 1, so an improbable category keeps only a few digits, and none once \texttt{inv\_\allowbreak{}cloglog(\allowbreak{}d)} rounds to 1.
\item[Observed] Intercept-only model, one row per category, thresholds (-1, 3, 3.375) (P = 0.308, 0.692, 1.89e-9, 2.03e-13): log likelihood -50.85601389939049, gradient off by up to 1.0e-4 relative. Thresholds (-1, 3, 4) (P(y = 4) = 1.94e-24): log likelihood -Inf, gradient -Inf. On the frozen case \texttt{cumulative\_\allowbreak{}cloglog} the log density is 5.9e-7 relative off (1.45e-4 absolute) and the gradient up to 1.3e-4.
\item[Expected] -50.85611467237852 (relative error 2e-6) and -76.22987349665763, with finite gradients; at the control thresholds (-1, 0, 1) brms agrees to 1.4e-16.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U03.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U03.out}.
\item[Fix] Evaluate every category on the log scale from the survival function \texttt{S(\allowbreak{}d) =\allowbreak{} 1 -\allowbreak{} inv\_\allowbreak{}cloglog(\allowbreak{}d) =\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}d))}, with \texttt{d\_\allowbreak{}k =\allowbreak{} tau\_\allowbreak{}k -\allowbreak{} eta}: \texttt{log P(\allowbreak{}y =\allowbreak{} 1) =\allowbreak{} log1m\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}d\_\allowbreak{}1))}, \texttt{log P(\allowbreak{}y =\allowbreak{} K) =\allowbreak{} -\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}d\_\allowbreak{}\{K-\allowbreak{}1\})}, and \texttt{log P(\allowbreak{}y =\allowbreak{} k) =\allowbreak{} -\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}d\_\allowbreak{}\{k-\allowbreak{}1\}) +\allowbreak{} log1m\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}(\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}d\_\allowbreak{}k) -\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}d\_\allowbreak{}\{k-\allowbreak{}1\})))} (that is, \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}diff\_\allowbreak{}exp} of the two log survival values).
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\\ Related but not the same: open PR \#1951 (Evaluate ordinal log\_lik and log\_softmax() on the log scale) is about brms's R-side log\_lik, not the Stan code.
\end{description}

\subsection{U04: The Beta family forms \texttt{1 -\allowbreak{} mu} by subtraction: digits lost, and \texttt{beta\_\allowbreak{}lpdf} rejects the draw once mu rounds to 1}
\label{U04}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: Beta(link = "logit" \textbar{} "probit" \textbar{} "cloglog") (generated Stan code). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] A11, E06 (\#32, \#71); divergence D13, D132.
\item[What] The second shape is \texttt{(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} mu) *\allowbreak{} phi} with \texttt{1 -\allowbreak{} mu} by subtraction: it loses \texttt{eps /\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} mu)} relative, and is exactly 0 above eta of about 37 (logit), 8.25 (probit; Stan's Phi is 1 there) and 3.6 (cloglog), where Stan's \texttt{beta\_\allowbreak{}lpdf} raises an error and the draw is rejected.
\item[Observed] y = 0.5, phi = 5: logit eta = 30 gives -30.47102418467954 (relative error 3.3e-5), eta = 40 an error (\texttt{beta\_\allowbreak{}lpdf: Second shape parameter[1] is 0}); probit eta = 8 gives -35.41504472969478 (1.9e-3), eta = 9 the error; cloglog eta = 3.4 gives -30.4337238232663 (1.2e-5), eta = 3.7 the error.
\item[Expected] -30.47000362924486 and -40.47000362924573 (logit), -35.48344078916028 and -44.09815274257785 (probit), -30.43410367664173 and -40.91730798931313 (cloglog); at the control points (eta = 1, 1, 0.5) brms agrees to 4e-15.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U04.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U04.out}.
\item[Fix] Take \texttt{1 -\allowbreak{} mu} from the link's other tail instead of subtracting: \texttt{inv\_\allowbreak{}logit(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}eta)}, \texttt{Phi(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}eta)}, \texttt{exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta))}, and pass \texttt{beta\_\allowbreak{}lpdf(\allowbreak{}y \textbar{} mu *\allowbreak{} phi,\allowbreak{} q *\allowbreak{} phi)} with that \texttt{q}. (Where even \texttt{q} underflows, about eta = 37.5 for probit, the shape needs \texttt{lgamma} from \texttt{log q}.)
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U05: Bernoulli and binomial cloglog likelihoods form a failure's \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} theta)} from \texttt{theta =\allowbreak{} inv\_\allowbreak{}cloglog(\allowbreak{}eta)}}
\label{U05}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: bernoulli(link = "cloglog"), binomial(link = "cloglog") (generated Stan code). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] A12 (\#36); divergence D18. Accepted with a 50-digit reference for the gradient (P6, \#47).
\item[What] \texttt{bernoulli\_\allowbreak{}lpmf(\allowbreak{}y \textbar{} inv\_\allowbreak{}cloglog(\allowbreak{}eta))} (and the binomial's) differentiates and evaluates \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} theta)} after \texttt{theta} has rounded: the gradient loses about \texttt{eps *\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta))} relative, and the log density of a failure is -Inf once theta rounds to 1 (eta of about 3.6), where the exact value is \texttt{-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta)}.
\item[Observed] Bernoulli y = 0: eta = 3 log likelihood -20.08553689560981 (1.4e-9), gradient -20.08553636927165 (2.8e-8); eta = 3.5: -33.12588265703288 (3.1e-4), gradient -33.46267700016426 (1\%); eta = 4: -Inf, gradient +Inf. Binomial 1 of 3: eta = 3.5 -65.15315302539764 (3.2e-4), eta = 4 -Inf. On the frozen case \texttt{bernoulli\_\allowbreak{}cloglog} one gradient entry is 3.8e-7 off.
\item[Expected] Bernoulli: \texttt{-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta)} = -20.08553692318767, -33.11545195869231, -54.59815003314424 (gradients equal). Binomial: \texttt{log 3 +\allowbreak{} log1m\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta)) -\allowbreak{} 2 exp(\allowbreak{}eta)} = -65.13229162871652 and -108.0976877776204. At eta = 0 brms agrees to 4e-16.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U05.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U05.out}.
\item[Fix] Write the likelihood on the log scale: a success adds \texttt{log1m\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta))}, a failure \texttt{-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta)}; the binomial \texttt{y log1m\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta)) -\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}n -\allowbreak{} y) exp(\allowbreak{}eta)} plus the log binomial coefficient.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U06: Bernoulli and binomial probit likelihoods are -Inf where Stan's Phi saturates (eta above 8.25 for a failure, below -37.5 for a success)}
\label{U06}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: bernoulli(link = "probit"), binomial(link = "probit") (generated Stan code). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] A12 (\#36); divergence D17.
\item[What] \texttt{bernoulli\_\allowbreak{}lpmf(\allowbreak{}y \textbar{} Phi(\allowbreak{}eta))}: Stan's \texttt{Phi} is exactly 1 above 8.25 and 0 below -37.5, so \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} theta)} of a failure is -Inf above 8.25 (and loses digits from about 5), and \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}theta)} of a success is -Inf below -37.5, with infinite or NaN gradients.
\item[Observed] Bernoulli y = 0: eta = 5 -15.06499839422134 (1.5e-11), eta = 8 -34.94504110044905 (2e-3; gradient 6.6\% off), eta = 8.5 and 9 -Inf. Bernoulli y = 1: eta = -38 -Inf (gradient +Inf), eta = -40 -Inf (gradient NaN). Binomial 0 of 3: eta = 8 -104.8351233013471, eta = 9 -Inf.
\item[Expected] \texttt{log Phi(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}eta)} = -15.06499839398873, -35.01343715991455, -39.19739642821767, -43.62814911333211; \texttt{log Phi(\allowbreak{}eta)} = -726.5572160188201 and -804.6084420137538; binomial -105.0403114797437 and -130.8844473399963. At eta = 0 brms agrees to 2e-16.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U06.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U06.out}.
\item[Fix] Use the log CDF: a success adds \texttt{std\_\allowbreak{}normal\_\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}eta)}, a failure \texttt{std\_\allowbreak{}normal\_\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}eta)} (binomial: \texttt{y std\_\allowbreak{}normal\_\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}eta) +\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}n -\allowbreak{} y) std\_\allowbreak{}normal\_\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}eta)} plus the log coefficient). Its value is exact in double precision down to -40 in these probes; its derivative carries U23's error until Stan Math fixes that.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U07: Hurdle and zero-inflated Poisson densities and the hurdle mean break at extreme linear predictors (+Inf, infinite or NaN gradients, NaN mean)}
\label{U07}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: hurdle\_poisson(), zero\_inflated\_poisson() (brms's Stan functions), posterior\_epred() of hurdle\_poisson(). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] B06 (\#39); divergence D28.
\item[What] A hurdle y \textgreater{} 0 row subtracts \texttt{log1m\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta))}, which is \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}0)} once \texttt{exp(\allowbreak{}eta)} underflows, so the row's log density is +Inf; a zero-inflated zero's gradient is NaN once \texttt{exp(\allowbreak{}eta)} overflows; the hurdle mean \texttt{mu /\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}mu)) *\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} hu)} is 0/0 where mu underflows.
\item[Observed] hurdle\_poisson, y = 1, hu = 0.3: eta = -740 log likelihood -0.3592542790478319 with gradient -Inf; eta = -750 +Inf with gradient NaN. zero\_inflated\_poisson, y = 0, zi = 0.3, eta = 710: value -1.203972804325936 (right) with gradient NaN. \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})} at eta = -750: NaN.
\item[Expected] y = 1: \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} hu) -\allowbreak{} mu/\allowbreak{}2} = -0.3566749439387422 at both points with gradient about 0; the zero-inflated zero \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}zi)} with gradient (0, 1 - zi); the hurdle mean's limit \texttt{1 -\allowbreak{} hu} = 0.7. At eta = 0 brms agrees to 2e-16.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U07.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U07.out}.
\item[Fix] Evaluate \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}mu))}, \texttt{mu =\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}eta)}, as \texttt{eta +\allowbreak{} log1p(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}mu /\allowbreak{} 2)} below eta of about -20 (and \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}expm1(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}mu))} above), so it never forms \texttt{log(\allowbreak{}0)}; the zero-inflated zero as \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}sum\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}log(\allowbreak{}zi),\allowbreak{} log1m(\allowbreak{}zi) -\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}eta))}, whose gradient is 0 where the second term is -Inf; the hurdle mean as \texttt{(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} hu) exp(\allowbreak{}eta -\allowbreak{} log(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}mu)))} with the same stable form (its limit 1 - hu).
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U08: \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}lik(\allowbreak{})} is -Inf, +Inf or NaN (or inexact) at extreme but finite linear predictors}
\label{U08}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: log\_lik(), loo(), waic() (R-side log-likelihoods of bernoulli, binomial, hurdle\_poisson, cumulative, mixture). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] C07 (\#49); divergence D49. The mixture case was described from brms's source in the row; here it is shown from output.
\item[What] The pointwise log-likelihood is evaluated in R from probabilities that round to 0 or 1, and a mixture's from a sum of component densities without factoring the largest out.
\item[Observed] Bernoulli logit y = 0: eta = 35.07 gives -34.94504110044905 (3.6e-3), eta = 40 -Inf. Binomial 0 of 3: eta = 27.2 -81.60011489079963 (1.4e-6), eta = 40 -Inf. hurdle\_poisson y = 1: eta = -26.9 -0.3566877935318438 (3.6e-5), eta = -60 +Inf. cumulative logit (-1, 0, 1): y = 4 at eta = -640 -Inf, y = 2 at eta = -640 NaN (with brms's warning that NAs were found). Two-Gaussian mixture at y = 40: -Inf.
\item[Expected] -35.07 and -40; -81.60000000000461 and -120; -0.3566749439397725 and -0.3566749439387351; -641 and -639.4586751453871; -762.1120857137646. Control rows (eta = 0, y = 0) agree exactly.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U08.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U08.out}.
\item[Fix] Evaluate each row on the log scale, as the Stan model does: logit \texttt{y eta -\allowbreak{} log1p\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta)} (binomial \texttt{y eta -\allowbreak{} n log1p\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}eta)} plus the coefficient); the hurdle as in U07; ordinal categories from \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}inv\_\allowbreak{}logit\_\allowbreak{}diff} or \texttt{plogis(\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{},\allowbreak{} log.\allowbreak{}p =\allowbreak{} TRUE)} of the tail; a mixture as \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}sum\_\allowbreak{}exp} over \texttt{log theta\_\allowbreak{}k +\allowbreak{} log p\_\allowbreak{}k}.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Partly related work upstream, not this problem as such.
\\ \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms/pull/1951} (open PR): Evaluate ordinal log\_lik and log\_softmax() on the log scale
\\ brms's development NEWS adds a warning when \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}lik} returns infinite values (\#1899), which reports the problem without removing it. The Bernoulli, binomial, hurdle and mixture rows were not found in the tracker.
\end{description}

\subsection{U09: Cumulative \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})} forms category probabilities by subtraction, losing digits between close thresholds}
\label{U09}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: posterior\_epred() of cumulative() (R side). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] B05 (\#41); divergence D39.
\item[What] P(y = k) is \texttt{plogis(\allowbreak{}tau\_\allowbreak{}k -\allowbreak{} eta) -\allowbreak{} plogis(\allowbreak{}tau\_\allowbreak{}\{k-\allowbreak{}1\} -\allowbreak{} eta)}, so a category between two close thresholds, or one small next to its neighbours in the upper tail, keeps only some of its digits.
\item[Observed] Thresholds (0, 1e-9, 2): P(y = 2) = 2.500000206850927e-10 (8.3e-8 relative); (0, 1e-6, 2): 1.4e-10; (-1, 20, 20.001): P(y = 3) = 2.06012984449444e-12 (3.1e-6) and P(y = 4) = 2.059093562323255e-09 (3.3e-8).
\item[Expected] 2.5e-10, 2.499999999999791e-07, 2.060123380581377e-12 and 2.059093494809622e-09; at (-1, 0, 1) brms agrees to 1.2e-16.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U09.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U09.out}.
\item[Fix] \texttt{plogis(\allowbreak{}b) -\allowbreak{} plogis(\allowbreak{}a) =\allowbreak{} plogis(\allowbreak{}a) *\allowbreak{} plogis(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}b) *\allowbreak{} expm1(\allowbreak{}b -\allowbreak{} a)} for \texttt{b \textgreater{} a} (no difference formed), or the exponential of the \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}inv\_\allowbreak{}logit\_\allowbreak{}diff} form the Stan code uses; the last category as \texttt{plogis(\allowbreak{}eta -\allowbreak{} tau\_\allowbreak{}\{K-\allowbreak{}1\})}.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U10: Truncated Gaussian \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})} loses its digits in the upper tail and is Inf or NaN beyond about 8.3 SD}
\label{U10}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: posterior\_epred() of gaussian() with trunc() (R side). Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] B02 (\#40); divergence D25. Accepted with a 50-digit reference for these expected values (P6, \#47).
\item[What] The truncated mean is formed with \texttt{pnorm(\allowbreak{}ub) -\allowbreak{} pnorm(\allowbreak{}lb)} by subtraction, so a bound several SD above the location loses the denominator's digits.
\item[Observed] mu = 0, sigma = 1, \texttt{y \textbar{} trunc(\allowbreak{}lb =\allowbreak{} L)}: L = 6.17 gives 6.324502577466615 (4.5e-8), L = 7.5 7.639864143170588 (1.4e-3), L = 8.2 9.005738961208227 (8.3\%), L = 9 Inf, L = 40 NaN. On the frozen case \texttt{gauss\_\allowbreak{}truncated} up to 1.05e-3 at 6 of 656 entries.
\item[Expected] \texttt{mu +\allowbreak{} sigma phi(\allowbreak{}z) /\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} Phi(\allowbreak{}z))}: 6.32450286358622, 7.628966391103763, 8.318567530824906, 9.108523105002844, 40.02496884720634; at L = 0 and 3 brms agrees to 6e-15.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U10.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U10.out}.
\item[Fix] Compute the ratio on the log scale: for a lower bound alone \texttt{mu +\allowbreak{} sigma exp(\allowbreak{}dnorm(\allowbreak{}a,\allowbreak{} log =\allowbreak{} TRUE) -\allowbreak{} pnorm(\allowbreak{}a,\allowbreak{} lower.\allowbreak{}tail =\allowbreak{} FALSE,\allowbreak{} log.\allowbreak{}p =\allowbreak{} TRUE))}, \texttt{a =\allowbreak{} (\allowbreak{}lb -\allowbreak{} mu) /\allowbreak{} sigma}; with two bounds take \texttt{Phi(\allowbreak{}b) -\allowbreak{} Phi(\allowbreak{}a)} from the tail both lie in (\texttt{pnorm(\allowbreak{}a,\allowbreak{} lower.\allowbreak{}tail =\allowbreak{} FALSE) -\allowbreak{} pnorm(\allowbreak{}b,\allowbreak{} lower.\allowbreak{}tail =\allowbreak{} FALSE)} when \texttt{a \textgreater{} 0}) or in log space.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U11: Interval censoring takes the mass as \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}diff\_\allowbreak{}exp} of two log CDFs, which loses every digit in the upper tail}
\label{U11}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: cens(c, y2) interval rows (generated Stan code), weibull\_lcdf, gamma\_lcdf. Inexact numerics; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] E04 (\#77); divergence D120. E04's probes used rstan::expose\_stan\_functions; here the same numbers come from brms models. \texttt{weibull\_\allowbreak{}censored\_\allowbreak{}interval\_\allowbreak{}post} could not be frozen on brms's default point box for this reason.
\item[What] An interval row (y, y2] gets \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}diff\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}y2),\allowbreak{} lcdf(\allowbreak{}y))}; in the upper tail both log CDFs are within a few eps of 0 (Stan 2.32's \texttt{weibull\_\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}5 \textbar{} 3,\allowbreak{} 1)} is 0 where the value is -exp(-125)), so the difference has no digits left. brms's own right-censored rows use the \texttt{lccdf} and are exact there.
\item[Observed] Weibull (scale 1) (5, 6] at shape 3: -Inf; (6, 8] at shape 2: -36.04365338911715 (= log(eps)); Gamma(2, rate 1) (40, 50]: -36.04365338911715.
\item[Expected] -125 (the mass is exp(-125) - exp(-216)), -36.00000000000069 and -36.28648440797372, from the survival functions; the right-censored Weibull row at 5 (brms -125.0000000000001) and the controls (0.5, 1] and (1, 2] agree to 6e-16.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U11.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U11.out}.
\item[Fix] Choose the tail per row: when \texttt{F(\allowbreak{}y) \textgreater{} 1/\allowbreak{}2} use \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}diff\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}lccdf(\allowbreak{}y),\allowbreak{} lccdf(\allowbreak{}y2))}, otherwise \texttt{log\_\allowbreak{}diff\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}y2),\allowbreak{} lcdf(\allowbreak{}y))}. (Stan Math could also return the upper tail of its lcdfs accurately, e.g. \texttt{weibull\_\allowbreak{}lcdf(\allowbreak{}y) =\allowbreak{} log1m\_\allowbreak{}exp(\allowbreak{}-\allowbreak{}(\allowbreak{}y /\allowbreak{} sigma)\textasciicircum{}alpha)}, \texttt{gamma\_\allowbreak{}lcdf =\allowbreak{} log1m(\allowbreak{}gamma\_\allowbreak{}q)} above the median, but the tail choice in brms suffices for any version.)
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] The same form for two-sided truncation is reported (open); interval censoring itself was not found.
\\ \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms/issues/1956} (open): Two-sided truncation in the Stan code loses the normalizer in the upper tail
\\ \url{https://github.com/stan-dev/math/pull/3037} (merged 2024-03-26): Make Weibull cdf \& lcdf more robust, handle y = 0 inputs
\\ \url{https://github.com/stan-dev/math/pull/3408} (open PR): Incomplete gamma gradient roots and log-space cdfs for six distributions
\\ Stan Math PR \#3037 (first in Math 4.9.0, newer than StanHeaders 2.32.10) may make \texttt{weibull\_\allowbreak{}lcdf} exact in its upper tail; not verified, since nothing newer could be installed.
\end{description}

\subsection{U12: gen\_extreme\_value \texttt{posterior\_\allowbreak{}epred(\allowbreak{})} is finite for xi \textgreater{} 1, NaN at xi = 0 and inexact near 0}
\label{U12}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: posterior\_epred() of gen\_extreme\_value(). Wrong result; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] E02 (\#75); divergence D114. brms 2.23 warns that the family is deprecated.
\item[What] The mean is evaluated as \texttt{mu +\allowbreak{} sigma (\allowbreak{}gamma(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} xi) -\allowbreak{} 1) /\allowbreak{} xi} for every xi: for 1 \textless{} xi \textless{} 2 \texttt{gamma(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} xi)} is negative and the 'mean' a finite negative number, though the mean is infinite for xi \textgreater{}= 1; at xi = 0 it is 0/0; near 0 \texttt{1 -\allowbreak{} xi} rounds away xi's low digits.
\item[Observed] mu = 0.1, sigma = 1, xi fixed in the formula: xi = 1.5 gives -2.929938467874022, xi = 0 NaN, xi = 1e-10 0.6772160527328651 (5.7e-7 relative). With xi estimated (D114's probe) -1.9e-3 at xi = 9.82.
\item[Expected] +Inf (no finite mean) for xi \textgreater{}= 1; \texttt{mu +\allowbreak{} sigma *\allowbreak{} euler} = 0.6772156649015323 at xi = 0; 0.6772156650004378 at xi = 1e-10; at the control xi = -0.5 brms is exact (0.3275461490944839).
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U12.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U12.out}.
\item[Fix] Return +Inf (or NA with a warning) for xi \textgreater{}= 1; otherwise \texttt{mu +\allowbreak{} sigma *\allowbreak{} expm1(\allowbreak{}lgamma(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} xi)) /\allowbreak{} xi} with \texttt{lgamma(\allowbreak{}1 -\allowbreak{} xi)} from its series \texttt{euler xi +\allowbreak{} sum\_\allowbreak{}\{k \textgreater{}=\allowbreak{} 2\} zeta(\allowbreak{}k) xi\textasciicircum{}k /\allowbreak{} k} when \textbar{}xi\textbar{} is small, whose limit at xi = 0 is \texttt{mu +\allowbreak{} sigma *\allowbreak{} euler}.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U13: \texttt{gr(\allowbreak{}g,\allowbreak{} by =\allowbreak{} )}: the SD prior's truncation constant is added once per coefficient, not once per by level}
\label{U13}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: (1 \textbar{} gr(g, by = gby)) (generated Stan code: lprior). Wrong result; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, rstan 2.32.7, StanHeaders 2.32.10, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] D08 (\#59); divergence D105. AutoBayes reproduces brms's constant (\texttt{1\textbar{}g\_\allowbreak{}sigma\_\allowbreak{}by\_\allowbreak{}normalisation}) to match it.
\item[What] Each of the Nby SD parameters has a half-normal (half-t, half-Cauchy) prior truncated at 0, but \texttt{lprior} adds \texttt{-\allowbreak{}log P(\allowbreak{}sd \textgreater{} 0) =\allowbreak{} log 2} only once per coefficient, so it is \texttt{(\allowbreak{}Nby -\allowbreak{} 1) log 2} too small. Sampling is unaffected; bridge sampling's marginal likelihood (and so Bayes factors) is off by that factor.
\item[Observed] gby with 3 levels, sd \textasciitilde{} normal(0, 1): lprior -5.96256441474146.
\item[Expected] -4.57627005362157, the difference -1.38629436111989 = -2 log 2; with gby of one level (the same compiled model) brms is exact (difference 4e-16).
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U13.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U13.out}.
\item[Fix] Multiply the truncation term by the number of SD elements, \texttt{M x Nby}, so each SD parameter's prior is normalised on (0, Inf).
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
\item[Known upstream] Not found in brms's NEWS or the issue tracker (read-only searches, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-23).
\end{description}

\subsection{U14: Grouping factor \texttt{g:h} joins labels with "\_", silently merging combinations whose joined labels coincide}
\label{U14}
\begin{description}[style=nextline, leftmargin=1.4em, itemsep=2pt]
\item[Where] brms: (1 \textbar{} g:h), make\_standata(). Wrong result; reproduced. Versions: brms 2.23.0, R 4.5.2.
\item[Found by] A03 (\#31); divergence D12.
\item[What] (g = "a\_b", h = "c") and (g = "a", h = "b\_c") both become "a\_b\_c" and so one group level, without a warning.
\item[Observed] Three distinct (g, h) combinations: \texttt{N\_\allowbreak{}1 =\allowbreak{} 2} levels, \texttt{J\_\allowbreak{}1 =\allowbreak{} 1 1 2 1 1 2} (rows of (a\_b, c) and (a, b\_c) in level 1).
\item[Expected] \texttt{N\_\allowbreak{}1 =\allowbreak{} 3}, the two combinations in different levels.
\item[Reproduce] \texttt{Rscript docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U14.R} from the repository root; it exits with status 1 while the problem is present. Output of one run: \texttt{docs/brms-parity/upstream/repro/U14.out}.
\item[Fix] Code the combined factor from the pair of levels (e.g. the pair's unique index, or \texttt{interaction(\allowbreak{}g,\allowbreak{} h,\allowbreak{} drop =\allowbreak{} TRUE)} with a separator that cannot occur in labels), or refuse joined labels that collide.
\item[Belongs in] \url{https://github.com/paul-buerkner/brms}
